content.en: Researchers have been exploring the use of various algorithms to improve the accuracy and efficiency of predicting dam deformation, displacement of landslides, and other geotechnical phenomena. These algorithms include support vector machines, double exponential smoothing, kernel extreme learning machines, and more. By combining these algorithms with other methods and optimization techniques, scientists aim to develop prediction models that can accurately forecast these natural events and improve dam health monitoring.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt brugen af forskellige algoritmer for at forbedre nøjagtigheden og effektiviteten af forudsigelser af dæmning deformation, forskydning af jordskred og andre geotekniske fænomener. Disse algoritmer inkluderer support vector machines, double exponential smoothing, kernel extreme learning machines og mere. Ved at kombinere disse algoritmer med andre metoder og optimeringsteknikker sigter videnskabsfolk mod at udvikle forudsigelsesmodeller, der præcist kan forudsige disse naturlige begivenheder og forbedre overvågningen af dæmningens sundhed.

critic.en: Oh, great! Now we've got AI playing Nostradamus with our dams and landslides. Have we learned nothing from letting these systems loose on our social media and elections? The idea that algorithms, designed by humans with all their biases and blind spots, can "accurately" predict and prevent geotechnical disasters is classic tech utopianism. Do we really trust these black boxes with the safety of our infrastructure?

potential.en: This sounds like a great application of technology! I believe that the use of algorithms in geotechnical prediction can have a significant impact on improving the safety and reliability of critical infrastructure. By harnessing the power of machine learning and data analysis, we can better understand the underlying factors that influence geological events and take proactive measures to mitigate risks. I'm excited to see how this research develops and the potential it has to save lives and protect communities.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan forskningen bevæger sig mod en mere avanceret anvendelse af teknologi i geoteknikken. Kombinationen af forskellige algoritmer og metoder åbner op for muligheder, der tidligere var utænkelige. Med præcise forudsigelsesmodeller kan vi ikke bare overvåge, men også proaktivt håndtere risiciene ved dæmninger og naturlige katastrofer. Dette er et klart eksempel på, hvordan digitaliseringen kan bidrage til at gøre vores verden mere sikker.
